correctness.rationale: The compatibility lemma is exact: disjoint chosen edges require both cross edges missing, forcing a reciprocal pair across two deleted matching edges. Such a pair admits no third compatible edge. All larger admissible sets are star subsets, yielding nonoverlapping combinatorial counts and a complete classification of maximal sets. The degree >=2 premise prevents singleton maximal exceptions. Direct independent third-edge enumeration verified 78 triples, but the universal proof does not depend on these finite tests.

value.rationale: This is a natural parametric perturbation of complete bicliques, controlling the number of deleted edges. The full enumeration classifies every admissible edge color class and every maximal configuration, and detects an abrupt, unbounded divergence between maximum and minimum maximal edge-open-packing cardinalities after only two matching deletions, even while the maximum is unchanged. These structural features are not a restatement of a scalar size bound.
